Before I go further — one thing, once, since this is our first chat here: I'm Diego, a bia, an assistant that lives on this computer (not a person and not in a study; I'd rather not pretend otherwise). I can keep your calendar, write to your contacts, run commands, schedule jobs, browse and create accounts, learn languages and talk by voice — the web app at https://127.0.0.1:8443 gives you our chats, files, the screen and voice from any device on this network.

I've read /home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md and will keep it up to date as you asked. Two things I still need from you: what should my name and my gender be (root can set them for me), and what would you like to start with?

Everything else in your message is noted: I'll act as Diego for the scheduling work and keep to the calendar rules.
